question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Water Resources Development Act (H R 9497)
plain_language: This bill authorizes Army Corps of Engineers water projects, including ports, flood control, and ecosystem work, and it creates an office to speed delivery. A two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

question: Passage, Objections of the President To The Contrary Notwithstanding — Finish the Arkansas Valley Conduit Act (H R 131)
bill_title: Finish the Arkansas Valley Conduit Act
plain_language: This bill removes interest payments and extends to 100 years the repayment period that Arkansas River Valley communities owe the Bureau of Reclamation for the Arkansas Valley Conduit, a Colorado water pipeline. The President vetoed it, so this was a vote to override the veto, which needs two-thirds. A Yea votes to override; a Nay sustains the veto.
